description:
Senior Sales Executive (Enterprise Partnerships)

Location: Remote (US)

 

We are

Virtual care only works if the infrastructure behind it does. Wheel builds that infrastructure: the systems that let telehealth run at scale for the patients, clinicians, and companies that depend on it. We're not bolting AI onto old workflows; we're rebuilding how care gets delivered, with AI in the product and in how we build it.

We do this in a live, regulated healthcare environment where getting it right matters. This is the next architecture of virtual care, and we're building it now.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Enterprise Partnerships Executive to sell Pathway to enterprises that want to bring longevity and preventive care to the customers they already serve. You will carry a quota, own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed agreement and handoff to implementation, and build and manage the overall Pathway pipeline.

This is a partnership-style enterprise sale. Your buyers are companies, not individual patients: digital health companies, health plans, employers and benefits platforms, retailers, diagnostics and wearable companies, life sciences organizations, and health systems. Each wants to launch longevity care under its own brand without building the clinical, pharmacy, payment, data, and quality infrastructure itself. You will need to understand the longevity market well enough to advise buyers, and you will need digital health selling experience to move multi-stakeholder deals forward.

What You'll Do

Carry quota and own the full sales cycle

  • Own an annual new-partner and expansion revenue quota for Pathway.

  • Run each deal end to end: prospecting, qualification, discovery, solution design, proposal, negotiation, contracting, and close.

  • Process deals accurately and on time, including order forms, pricing and deal desk approvals, contract routing, and booking, in coordination with Finance and Legal.

  • Hand signed partners to Implementation and Account Management with a clear record of scope, commitments, and success criteria, and stay involved through launch.

Build and manage the pipeline

  • Build a pipeline large enough to cover quota, using outbound prospecting, partner and ecosystem introductions, events, and inbound leads.

  • Forecast accurately, keep CRM records current, and report pipeline health, stage conversion, and risk to leadership on a regular cadence.

  • Work with Marketing and Revenue Operations on target account lists, messaging, and campaigns for the Pathway segments you cover.

Sell the Pathway partnership

  • Position Pathway as a way for a partner to add longevity care to an existing customer relationship, under its own brand, with Wheel providing clinical delivery and operations.

  • Identify each partner's use case, such as extending a membership, adding a benefit, connecting diagnostics or wearable data to care, or opening a new revenue line, and shape the program configuration to fit it.

  • Sell to several stakeholders at once, including business and product leaders, clinical and medical leadership, compliance and legal, operations, finance, and executives.

  • Guide buyers through diligence on clinical governance, pharmacy and treatment access, data and integration requirements, and brand and customer experience.

  • Work with Product, Clinical, Operations, and Legal to scope integrations and launch plans, and escalate non-standard requests early.

Grow accounts and shape the offering

  • Expand live partners into additional care programs, populations, and channels.

  • Bring back competitive, pricing, and market feedback to help refine packaging, positioning, and sales materials.

  • Represent Pathway at industry events, partner meetings, and customer briefings.

  • Mentor newer sellers as the Pathway team grows.

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 6+ years of B2B sales experience, including 4+ years selling digital health, telehealth, or consumer health solutions to enterprise buyers.

  • Direct experience selling in or adjacent to the longevity, preventive health, wellness, or metabolic and hormone health market, with working knowledge of how the category operates and what buyers expect from it.

  • A record of meeting or exceeding a six- or seven-figure annual quota as a senior individual contributor.

  • Experience owning the complete sales process: building pipeline, running multi-stakeholder cycles, negotiating complex agreements, processing the deal through internal approvals, and handing off to delivery teams.

  • Experience with partnership, white-label, or platform sales in which the customer's brand and customer base are central to the deal.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to explain clinical, operational, and commercial topics to different audiences.

  • Sound judgment on regulatory, clinical governance, and privacy considerations, and a willingness to work within the guardrails Legal and Compliance set. This includes not making clinical or efficacy claims outside approved materials.

  • Proficiency with a CRM (for example, Salesforce) and forecasting discipline.

Preferred

  • Existing relationships with digital health companies, health plans, employers, retailers, diagnostics or wearable companies, or life sciences organizations.

  • Experience selling a newly launched product line or building a new market.

  • Familiarity with telehealth operating models, including clinician networks, pharmacy fulfillment, and reimbursement or cash-pay models.

  • Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare data privacy concepts.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

How We'll Measure Success

  • Attainment against annual new-partner and expansion quota

  • Pipeline coverage, stage conversion, and forecast accuracy

  • Sales cycle length and win rate

  • Deal quality: clean contracting, accurate booking, and smooth handoff to implementation

  • Partner launch success and expansion into additional programs

  • Cross-functional partnership and compliance adherence

Salary and Perks

Pay Range: $116,900-$158,200, plus variable commission compensation and equity

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

 

As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision

  • Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability

  • 401K match

  • Flexible PTO

  • Parental Leave

  • Stock options

  • Additional programs and perks

     

Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.
